author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a pill handset on two cradle posts over a domed base with a round dial; reads as a desk telephone, though with the plain handset it can also suggest a weighing scale. The rejected drawing had a boxy base and a tiny dial. An arched or drooping handset was checked but forces the base top below y 27, leaving no room for any dial.
omissions: The handset's drooping ear/mouth pieces are drawn as round pill ends, and the dial is small (r3): handset, 8-unit post gap and a dial 9 from the base top and bottom use the full 40-unit height.
drawing_plan: VRECT_L symmetric about x 24: handset pill y 4..12 (x 8..40, r4 ends); posts x 20/28 from 12 to 20; base top y 20 (x 20..28), r12 shoulders to the sides at y 32, r2 bottom corners, bottom y 44; dial ring r3 at (24,32).
